environment.description: IoT gateway service running in a Docker container (python:3.11-slim base) on an EC2 instance. Container runs with default Docker seccomp profile. The gRPC service is exposed on port 50051 via an NLB (Network Load Balancer) with no L7 inspection. The container runs as root with CAP_SYS_ADMIN. No metadata filtering or input sanitization middleware is configured on the gRPC interceptor chain.
